in_marathi.name: Samiksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे To examine, observe, contemplate
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samiksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Samiksha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'samiksha' meaning 'to examine, observe, contemplate'. This name carries a deep spiritual significance in Hindu culture, symbolizing the importance of introspection, reflection, and wisdom.
